title: Product Manager: Cross-channel feedback summary
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Give me the cross-channel feedback picture before the weekly product review.

answer.question: Give me the cross-channel feedback picture before the weekly product review.
answer.answer:
Here's the cross-channel snapshot from the ProductFeedbackSynthesizerAgent (feedback_summary):

**10,150 items analyzed, last quarter:**
- Zendesk tickets: 8,500 (83.7%)
- Jira feature requests: 1,200 (11.8%)
- App Store reviews: 280 (2.8%)
- G2 reviews: 170 (1.7%)

**Sentiment: 7.2/10** (up from 6.8 in Q2)
- Positive: 62% (+5.9 pts)
- Neutral: 23% (stable)
- Negative: 15% (-5.9 pts)

Overall trend is improving, but support tickets still dominate volume — worth digging into. Want me to pull **top pain points** and **most-requested features** next so you walk into the review with the full picture (and optionally the Q1 priority matrix and sentiment trend chart)? All synthetic insight — nothing gets committed or ticketed without your sign-off.
